purpose: Explicit ledger of skill identities found during enumeration that are not promoted to canonical records because Xenoverse 2-specific class/subcategory evidence is insufficient or conflicting.
rules: Do not invent class/subcategory, Ki cost, acquisition, DLC, CaC availability, or Ultimate Finish requirements.
A gap may be promoted only after Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes the required field(s).
Historical or cross-game evidence is retained as corroboration, not treated as current Xenoverse 2 proof.

gaps.name: Acid
gaps.known_identity: Cast-exclusive Super used by Saibaman variants
evidence: Xenoverse 2 character/skill enumeration identifies Acid as a cast-only Saibaman skill and CaC-unavailable.
Xenoverse 2-specific community documentation records Acid on Saibaman 2, the Crystal Raid/Training-only Saibaman preset.
Xenoverse 2 reference material distinguishes Acid from Saibabeam and identifies Saibaman variants as users.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes the skill identity, cast-only/CaC-unavailable boundary, and Crystal Raid/Training Saibaman-2 presence, but the repository's canonical Ki-cost and acquisition/unlock fields remain unverified.

gaps.name: Howl
gaps.known_identity: Great Ape-exclusive skill used by Great Ape enemies
evidence: Great Ape Festival and related Xenoverse 2 PQ enemy tables list Howl on Great Ape Nappa, Vegeta and Bardock.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact identifies Howl as Evasive Skill ID 10440 and marks it CaC-unavailable.
A dated Xenoverse 2 save-data reference independently labels Howl as an Evasive skill and documents its activation restriction/behavior.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes the Evasive classification and CaC restriction, but a sufficiently direct source for the repository's Ki-cost field and canonical unlock/acquisition endpoint has not been established.

gaps.name: Boiling Burg
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 540 to Boiling Burg, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its user.
Xenoverse 2 Legend Patrol evidence lists Boiling Burg in Final Form Demigra's moveset.
Xenoverse 2-specific CaC-unobtainable skill catalog independently lists Boiling Burg.
Xenoverse 2 Demigra reference material describes Boiling Burg as Final Demigra's Ultimate attack and its in-game behavior.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes Boiling Burg as a CaC-unavailable Ultimate used by Final Form Demigra. The canonical Ki-cost field remains unverified; no numeric cost is inferred from other games or mod data.

gaps.name: Energy Boil
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 10540 to Energy Boil, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its source.
A Xenoverse 2 Demigra restoration/mod artifact explicitly describes Energy Boil as functioning as an evasive for Final Form Demigra.
A Dragon Ball reference independently identifies Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill and describes its energy/teleport/ki-gathering behavior.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence now establishes the Evasive classification and CaC restriction, but the repository's canonical subcategory and Ki-cost fields remain unverified.

gaps.name: Baked Sphere
evidence: Xenoverse 2 character ID list identifies Baked Sphere as skill ID 531 and CaC-unavailable.
Xenoverse 2-specific Future Warrior documentation identifies Baked Sphere as the Masked Future Warrior's Ultimate Skill and a Crystal Raid Supervillain-state skill.
Xenoverse 2 community catalog explicitly lists Baked Sphere among skills unobtainable by CaC.
Xenoverse 2 gameplay documentation and character move lists place Baked Sphere in Supervillain-controlled character movesets.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Baked Sphere as a CaC-unavailable Ultimate associated with Supervillain/Masked Future Warrior usage. The repository's canonical Ki-cost field remains unverified; no cost is inferred from another game or unofficial implementation.

gaps.name: Boulder Toss
gaps.known_identity: Great Ape-exclusive Super Skill used by Great Ape enemies
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Boulder Toss skill ID 441, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Great Ape as its source.
Xenoverse 2 PQ and Expert Mission tables repeatedly list Boulder Toss on Great Ape Nappa and/or Great Ape Vegeta.
Xenoverse 2-specific reference material identifies Boulder Toss as a Super Skill used by Great Apes.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Boulder Toss as a CaC-unavailable Super Skill used by Great Apes. The repository taxonomy subtype and canonical Ki cost remain unverified; the physical/projectile description is not converted into a repository subtype without a direct taxonomy mapping.
